name: Mealie
short_description: Self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner. with meal planning.
description: Mealie is a self-hosted recipe manager and meal planner with a REST API backend and a reactive frontend. Import recipes from any URL, plan your weekly meals, generate shopping lists, and share recipes with your household all in one place.
usecases: Import and store recipes from any website automatically.
Plan weekly meals and generate shopping lists.
Share a household recipe collection with family members.
